issues.problem: ctx1 (三月に入って、…の日々が続いている) could be filled by the near-synonym 一進一退 (yj042), which also takes の日々.
issues.action: Changed 日々 to 陽気 (weather), so only a weather idiom fits; English updated.

issues.problem: The how line and ctx4 used 和洋折衷な; the standard form is 和洋折衷の. ctx2 ended …オムレツという和洋折衷だ, which sounds unfinished.
issues.action: Changed な to の in the how line and ctx4; ctx2 now reads …という和洋折衷の献立だ, English updated.

issues.problem: Story (Chao Cuo's memorial to Emperor Wen, recorded in 漢書 食貨志: 賦斂不時，朝令而暮改) checked and kept. ctx2 (会社の方針が…で) fits 二転三転 just as well. The ctx4 English added 'management', which is not in the Japanese.
issues.action: ctx2 now has orders from the top (トップの指示が朝令暮改で) and English that says they are reversed as soon as they are given; ctx4 English now ends 'nobody will trust them any more'.

issues.problem: ctx5 (…は、二転三転の末、ようやく決まった) fits 紆余曲折 (yj060, 紆余曲折の末) just as well.
issues.action: Rewrote it so the site moves back and forth (北口から南口へ、また北口へと二転三転した); English updated.
